name: uc41_display
notes: Universal Controller 4.1 (Tip Charger) display - do NOT flash onto a Plasma StandAlone panel. 4.1.39B (= bench build 4.1.39C, bench-verified 2026-11-16): auto-on when tips go in, auto-off ~1-2 s after tips come out under plasma EMI (brief plasma-off sensor check on a reading >90), plasma never past the slider time + 0.5 s (888 blinks if the cap acts), smoothed power/vac flow, timer/cooling fixes, STOP from any screen, pump stays on between cycles. On-screen label still reads 4.1.38 (graphics unchanged). Program only (.4XE), uSD untouched. Recovery: the original 4.1.38 file stays at display-uc41/uc41_display_4.1.38.4XE (use Flash my compiled build). Flash over a direct 4D USB programmer.
